==Senator Elections==
Each summit, a number of nations will elect [[Senator|senators]] for one or more of their territories to serve in the [[Senate]]. Each nation has a unique method of electing its senators. At the Spring Equinox 386YE, the following nations will elect Senators at the listed times inside the nation's camp:

<small>
#{{anchor|1}} The next regular election for this senatorial title will take place at the Summer Solstice 386YE
</small>

==Timetable==
This timetable and much more information can be seen on the notices that get pinned up all around the Hub after time-in. <br />
For any queries regarding the IC timetabling at events you can talk to the civil service staff in the Hub.
